title: Fix StreamStatsPanel missing dark mode styles
description: The StreamStatsPanel (src/components/layout/stream-stats-panel.tsx) uses only light-mode classes throughout: the StatBadge component defines colors like 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border-blue-200' without any dark: variants. The panel container uses 'bg-white border border-gray-200' without dark equivalents. Section headings use 'text-red-700', 'text-purple-700', 'text-blue-700' without dark variants. Tag pills use 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border-purple-200' etc. without dark: counterparts. The list item text uses 'text-gray-700' without dark variant. Fix: Add dark: variants to StatBadge colors (e.g., 'dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-800'), panel container ('dark:bg-gray-800 dark:border-gray-700'), headings, tags, and text. Use the patterns already established in sipoc-node.tsx which uses the exact same color palette with dark variants.
